text:
A pretty average sushi place with The name that I find to be kind of a turn off. I was expecting to have more than a "sushi meal" experience but that's what I got... very little originality and what I found to be very average quality.

The staff seemed to be pretty pleasant, perhaps above average, so a pretty good thing. I just can't find anything to rave about with this place. Perhaps it was that my expectations were high that it would be kind of fancy or something but again I wasn't impressed. But I will say is that there was nothing bad about it...just very average.

Went in on 2/17/20 for happy hour. Was told they didn't do happy hour on a holiday, even though there was a giant sign in the lobby advertising it. The bartender was very rude and abrupt. I attempted to contact them on their website and no response. Terrible customer service, will not be going back and will tell everyone I know. AVOID, so many other nice places in Cherry Hill with better customer service.

Chicken finger are claimed to be hand breaded, however they store brought and microwave prepared.

The gyro was amazing and nicely presented.  The American cheeseburger so so.

Great ambiance, but we left puzzled by all the good reviews. We started with a caprese salad which was good. I ordered a meatball on the side and pollo al forno. The chicken was bland and had no flavor whatsoever. The meatball had the same issue. My wife's wine was served in a juice cup. She had spaghetti and a meatball, she did not like it either. Service was quite good, but couldnt get around how flavorless the food was.

A newly added gem to the Fountain Square neighborhood. I resisted the bougie-esque coffee addition up until last month. We went in for coffee and were pleasantly surprised with the caffeinated, kombucha, and dairy-free options filling up the menu. We got a matcha latte and a flavored cold brew and both were delicious. Grateful for the owners who opened this restaurant up on this side of town.

I've been going to this diner for years and always had a good experience. However, I doubt I'll be going back because one of the waitresses was wearing some type of vanilla perfume I am highly allergic to and I can't expose myself to those toxic chemicals. If you have any respiratory problems or multiple chemical sensitivities (MCS) like me, it would be best to avoid this place.

I have been here several times.  3 actually.  Every time everything has been delicious.  This time I got the Dutch/German pancake.  It's like a mix between a pancake and a bread pudding.  It's great.  Last time I had the baked vegetarian omelette, which was awesome.  One of the best breakfast places I have ever been to.  Highly recommend it.
do not let the size fool you!!! this place was great the food was not just amazing the service was even better!!! love  love  love!!!

To start, I believe my experience of this joint should be a 3.5 stars but unfortunately, half stars are not an option.

We arrived on a cold night where the snow was still melting, in search of Asian food in downtown Indy. We love the Thai places back home so I figured it couldn't hurt to try one in a new place!

To start, I ordered a cocktail while my partner ordered a beer. Upon taste, I could tell it was made with cheap liquor as it tasted like rubbing alcohol and the flavors did not pair well together. We also requested the calamari and spring rolls as appetizers. The calamari was honestly average and I felt that I could've gotten the same flavor from getting a frozen bag from the store and putting it in the air fryer. The spring rolls were not the freshly rolled ones we thought they'd be and tasted like the ones you get at a Chinese restaurant which are premade. To be clear, we did not order the spring rolls until after we put in the calamari and we asked the server if they had spring rolls which was not clarified to be egg rolls deep-fried. 

The spiciness of the dishes was apparent my our water cups constantly being empty and we ordered only a 3 on a 1-6 scale. There were huge chunks of vegetables that took over my Pad Kee Mao as well as tough, not very flavorful hunks of beef which brought down the good flavor of the noodles. The "sauce" on both noodle dishes could've been more as well as it was not flavored intensely. 

Thus, I took the risk of trying a new place tha

I've been here a number of times, but all before  becoming a Yelper. We met some friends for a Saturday evening "grub club" so I once again have the opportuniTy to review. 

The patio was closed off as it's bloody cold outside and they had sat the group at a large table insidE. The place was bustling and somewhat loud. I did find it kind of hard to talk to and hear my table companions throughout the dinner. We were seated in the room with many other large groups, so I'm sure that's why it was kind of loud.

The server had no problem with splitting our bills, as we gave her a heads up. She promptly greeted us and offered to grab us drinks. Service was friendly and efficient, even on a busy Saturday night. 

My wife and I shared the Ahi Tuna appetizer and the tuna looked and tasted fresh. The wonton chips were nice flavor and consistency. The cocktail "The Philosopher" hit the spoT as well. A good drink for the whiskey lover in your group. We shared the bread pudding  and some port for dessert. The bread  pudding was moist, sweet, and just so delicious! Probably my favorite part of the meal.

I always enjoy Wild Grille, I just look forward to the warmer weather where the riverside dinIng can be enjoyed!

Very nice staff. Pretty bad boba tea. 

The tea (around $4.50 if you get boba) tasted like it was sweetened with Splenda which completely threw me off. I love Boba tea but have never had it taste like that..

We ordered Pomegranate Passionfruit Tea, Pomegranate Black Tea, and Peach Green Tea. Unfortunately none were good. We were also thrown off by the fact that Passionfruit tea was a base tea as I've only seen Black, Green or Oolong teas as base teas.

Their boba was also not the right consistency (not firm enough tasted more like jelly than boba) and was the smallest portion of boba I have ever gotten. Ever. Pretty disappointed.

What a beautiful space!! While I haven't had the pleasure of an overnight stay (YET), I did enjoy the lobby and rooftop bar and all I can say is WOW!

Stopped in after a show at the Symphony and could not have been more blown away. From the wonderful scent that greets you when you walk in, to the pieces of artwork and the elegant placements of varying installations and spacing of furniture, every little attention to detail is obvious. 
The rooftop bar is breezy with a fabulous city scape as your backdrop. 

Can't wait to come back!!

You can't fix incompetence I guess. Ordered pizzas for a party to be ready at 11:45. Got there  at 11:45 on the nose; pizzas hadn't even been made, let alone cooked. Not so much as an apology for wasting my time. I'd give a negative rating if I could, or at least zero stars..
Food was decent and in a very beautiful part of Florida, St. Pete Beach! Chicken sausage and home potatoes were the best!

The very very best sushi in Reno! Hands down our favorite place to go. It is always busy and the service is always exceptional. Such a great menu selection and it's incredibly fresh, definitely seems the freshest of all the places in Reno. We love coming here and we always highly recommend it to other people. Love it!

My friend and l had the most uncomfortable experience at Seis kitchen on River Rd, which is unfortunate bc the El Mercado location is superb. The wheelchair access for my friend was not suitably adequate. When ordering l got rapid fire questioning from Maya which did not enhance the dining experience. We then sat at a we t table. Food was good but setting and rushed atmosphere wasn't.

A hidden spot on the corner of the plaza. The restaurant sitting is on the 2nd floor. Anyway, there was no complaints over here! The food meet our expectations and the staff were attentive to our need!! We'll be back again!

This place is just what I have been looking for. Delicious salad with so many choices. You can also get soup, limited hot meals & make your own wrap. Reasonably priced (I was a bit nervous I would end up with $30 salad).All the ingredients seems so fresh. Lots of room to dine in & very clean. I will definitely be returning. Only minor complaint was they played music that was a bit loud so you feel you have to over talk it to have a conversation.

Their sushi is tasty and versatile. Great pricing and great service! Highly recommend. Every time we order take-out from them the order is totally correct, including the extra sauces and such we request. 

The sushi is always super fresh and everyone I am with can always find something they like.

The mai tai I ordered here was both beautiful and delicious, the price of it was not. It seemed pretty expensive for what you get. My group also ordered a round of green tea shots that ended up being $11 a piece (not disclosed to us beforehand). It was a hot summer evening and there were not enough fans or anything to cool it down. We were sweating the whole time. The bartenders and servers were great, however, the prices seemed too high.
We had exceptional food, exquisite tea, and excellent service! We will be going back. It is a hidden treasure in St. Louis!
Amazing Italian cuisine with high end cocktails.  Then margarita pizza is unreal!

Went here for my birthday as I am a seafood lover. The service was good and the seafood was fresh and the presentation, eye catching. My food was good but the sauce could have been more seasoned, I've had better seafood sauce. I ordered the combo with a whole lobster, shrimp, Dungeness crab clusters with corn and potatoes. I would definitely go back.

Long line. Food was average. There are better po boys in the city for about the same price. Maybe because it was busy but the cashier and a couple of staff were rather rude to me. They also mixed my order up and ignored me while I try to ask for help. Maybe they should expand and try to alleviate some stress on the staff.

Billy Goat is our local coffee shop and we actually didn't find it until the quarantine started. We wanted to support local businesses and we're so glad we discovered this gem. The cold brew coffee is very good and they have a variety of syrups, which is always fun to try. The service is always good and we're excited to continue visiting here now that they're fully open again. If you're in the area and want good local coffee (they roast their own), then definitely stop in!

This was my first time stopping in at their uptown location. A few weeks ago, someone smashed their window! Not cool! So I wanted to pay them a visit :)
COVID procedures were less seating, must wear a mask, baristas wear masks, and contactless payment.
I wish I could remember the name of the barista who served me. She was so sweet. She knew exactly what kinds of breads they had fresh that day and exactly where they were to show me. Even though I didn't get a loaf this day, I got an awesome gorgeous croissant. Ohhh it was delicious. I also got an iced chai. Also delicious  I will definitely be back next time I find myself uptown in the early morning!
Sandy was our server last night, she was on top of everything. We didn't have to ask for refills for our drinks. The food was worth every penny!
Multiple floors with multiple bars. Highly recommend the outdoor seating on the second floor. Service is a bit slow, but the food and beer menu are worth the wait.

If you had the great pleasure of eating food at Kenji's when they were a food truck, you're in luck. Kenji's has a restaurant that's open 5 days a week- 10-4 pm. 
Kenji's usually has the longest lines at the food truck events and for good reason. The kalua pork tacos are some of the best on earth. Great flavor, good amount of spice and wonderful cucumber mix. 
There lunch plates are amazing and Joe and his wife, Kelly are very gracious hosts. 
Great news, they'll be at Food Truck Friday's this summer.

I took my girlfriend on our date night to Barcelona and we had one of the best nights we've had all year. They took great precautions to protect their guest and themselves from covid. I highly suggest you ask for Nick as your server. He was extremely knowledgeable and guided me and my girlfriend through the wine selections and numerous food options they had available. My girlfriend is very picky and the only meats she eats are chicken and shrimp. She ended up trying octopus, proscuitto, and pork that night and was so delighted with the smaller dishes allowing her to try new things. We also had the flan and olive cake(Delicious!), add a scoop of ice cream. This is a great, modern and sexy place for a date or a gathering of friends. Again ask for Nick, he made it a night we won't forget.

So I heard about this place from a friend who lives in the area.  So while on vacation in New Orleans I knew that I  couldn't leave without eating here. I was so glad that I did however I wish that I hadn't waited until the day before I was leaving town. I ordered the gator and pork sauage poboy and it was the best poboy ever! The bread was perfect and there was plenty of meat and so delicious and huge. I was only able to eat half due to the fact that I ordered boudan balls that was great! I know when I return I will be eating here more than once.
It was one of the better BBQ joints! Large portion sizes. Very tasty. The bathrooms smell like cedar. Cute decor. Nice service. Overall a very good experience.

Got the breakfast burrito, it was OK. The portion was large. It came with either grits or potatoes. I got the grits and it was pretty watery. Hubby got the eggs Benedict, had to send back to kitchen as the egg was raw. Service was good.

Simple. Best meal of the Covid year! Amazing flavor. Great service. Ample spacing between tables for social distancing. Staff wearing masks correctly. This place never fails for its price point. In my top 5 places to eat in Indy.

it is really hard to find good Pizza in Wilmington. that said Mazzella's Pizza is really good. they are the best I have found in the area. of course Pizza is only a small portion of what they do. they have a very complete menu of Italian classics and all of them are good. if you are like me and are always looking for the best Pizza check them out. you will be hard pressed to find better pizza in Wilmington than at Mazzella's.

Didn't expect it but, Penrose Diner was certainly phenomenal. Flavorful menu items and outstanding service. Probably the most tasty menu item for me was Turkey Club. The working staff was very attentive and extremely knowledgeable of the menu items. I definitely see myself returning here in the future.
Excellent service by the food servers and manager.  Very polite and considerate.  Aimed to please.  I had the catfish and it was outstanding.

Best beignets I ever had. Waited in the line for 30 minutes and worth every minute. I won't be waiting in the line next time as people were just walking from the other entrance and just grabbing tables.

When I made the reservation I was NOT told the entire hotel was under renovation, the only mention of renovation was that the hotel was only offering breakfast, which was fine. I was traveling with a 92 yo and called at 2:30 hoping to get her checked in half an hour early because I knew we could not be back until late in the evening. I was told they don't do "early check-in" because that is when they are cleaning rooms. Now I don't believe EVERY room in the hotel is still being cleaned a half hour before check-in but I accepted his stupid claim and ended up not checking in until after seven at night. By the time we arrived we were both tired and just wanted our room. We had to wait for another group to check in, in a lobby with NO stick of furniture to even sit down, plastic hanging over large sections of the room. Elevators had walls covered with construction sheets so my elderly tired companion could not even use the hand-rails, it WAS a construction zone.

While my aunt checked in I loaded up our luggage in a luggage trolley and when she got the keys we used the awkward trolley (not sure if it had a bad wheel, it was not rolling properly) to get our luggage to the elevator after being given directions to it by the desk clerk. When we got to the elevator we looked at the key and they had not given us the room number, instead I found a smiley face sticking it's tongue out at me, quite literally. I was forced to make my way all the way back to the desk because this nitwit sen
Excelente atención, Bella decoración, buen ambiente, comida riquísima!!! Muyyyyy recomendable !!

I think of this place as a chipotle of Indian food - you can get a naanwich or rice bowl and add toppings as you like. I have gotten their food delivered before and to be honest I thought some of the chutney and topping options are overkill but then again I am an Indian person who eats homemade Indian food on the reg so I'm hard to please. That's why I was so impressed by their simple options at the IUPUI regatta - rice topped with chicken with tikka masala sauce with just a little onion and cilantro on top is the PERFECT way to consume Indian food in a fast casual way. I think in the future I might forgo some of the extra things and be more simplistic in my orders because their food speaks for itself and doesn't needs frills. Even though it's a more fast food style Indian food I gotta say this is some of the only good Indian food I've had outside of my mother's kitchen in Indy. I'm glad they are right next to me and I'm going to be ordering way more now that I know the secret formula to making their menu work for me: simplicity.
First visit...very cute decor, food was good, service as well!  Can't wait to go back!

I have always liked Johnny Sanchez, especially for Taco Tuesdays.  Amazing deals, especially on Tuesday nights.  Good Margaritas, and I also like their desserts.  Usually fairly boisterous.  Good Mexican food.

I pass this location every day on the way to work and have wanted to try the breakfast wrap. This is only my third Yelp review in the Philly area, and unfortunately it is because the breakfast wrap at Panera was so terrible! One third of the dry and cardboard tasting wrap (flatbread maybe?) had nothing inside it. And that was better than when I tasted the egg, bacon and cheese part. The egg was actually over cooked and dry! How do you manage that? The cheese was a gooey and super sweet mess. And the bacon was more maple syrup than bacon in terms of flavor. I was hungry but actually stopped eating rather than finish this. What a disappointment!

My sister and I took a day trip to Nashville and we just had to stop by a Frothy Monkey - and I'm so glad we were able to! Our iced monkey mocha latte was everything! This review is a couple days late - but shout out to the Friday night shift crew for being so accommodating and friendly! Y'all are rockstars.
Favorite Chick-fil-A with great customer service! Always very quick even when the line is out to the main road!

First this place is really hard to find. You go to where it says for the address and can't find it. It's in club 700. Enter the club and go to the very back. Yes keep walking. 21+ older. Limited seating in the back but you can sit in the bar area. 

We ordered the bistro burger. Which the burger was cooked well done. Which was fine but it would have been nice to cook it a little less or if there is an option to request how you want it cooked. Overall the burger was fine. 

We had the Mac and cheese bites. Those were unique and delicious. Basic marinara sauce to dip them in. They surprisingly didn't fall apart. 

But our favorite was the piggyback fries. I had these for my meal and only ate 1/4-1/3 of them. Huge to share with layers of cheese. Delicious pulled pork and bacon on it.
Wow this place has really fresh fish flown in from Japan. Nothing I taste before I will come back and recommend to people who are looking for fresh sashimi sushi. The best in stl, that's for sure

Used to be my favorite ice cream stop but today I was very disappointed to find they do not serve 'no added sugar' flavors anymore. My granddaughter was very happy with her specialty cone and black cherry ice cream. The staff are always pleasant and it is nice to sit outside in the fresh air. I hope they will consider a sugar free or no added sugar feature in the future.

Been driving past this place for a while, decided to finally come in and give it a try. The environment is awesome. Really open space, bringing the outside in, trees inside. Loved the space. Ordering was a bit of a mess as there were only little Togo menus and you could only order on screen, but the on screen did not provide any information about the food. I have a lot of good allergies so I found this difficult and a little inconvenient. I ended up with eggs, vegan cheese, turkey bacon, spinach, and tomatoes, a peach tea for a drink, and sweet potatoes as a side. The food was ordered and they brought it to the table, they mixed up my companion and my order, but it was all sorted out. Flavor of the food was not there. It was very bland. Nothing more, nothing less than what I ordered. Nothing stood out. Bland food I can deal with, it was after I left that I realized I was having a reaction to their food. I have a dairy allergy and thought I would be safe with what I selected. I'm not sure if they put milk in their eggs or if someone mistakenly gave me regular cheese when they mixed up my companion and my food. But after eating here I immediately became very ill. Save yourself time and money and don't dine here. It's good for pictures, but nothing more.

You can't go wrong eating here. I've been here so many times and never had a bad meal. I especially love their beet salad (I know it's a salad but don't knock it until you've tried it) and the salted caramel budino and have to order these two items every single time I'm here.

I always seem to have a good overall experience at Olive Garden!  I typically eat at this location  2-3 times per month and have never been disappointed yet.  Great tasting food, excellent service, good value and a pleasing atmosphere all come together to create an overall wonderful dinning experience.   The management here does a good job at ensuring that every visit is a near-perfect experience!   Keep up the great work Citrus Park Olive Garden!

Went here in the motorcycle with my fiancé.  This was my second time here.  1st time, I wasn't impressed...this time however, I was.  The only reason I didn't give a 5 star was I reserve those for places that cannot be duplicated.  It is Covid time but they really have it down pat.  Lots of seating and everyone is very attentive to all their customers.  We ordered the Tails, (smoker sauce was amazing) Cajun fries and corn fritter things.  We got the filet mignon sandwich to go for my son.  Everything was amazing!  The boneless wings and fries were done perfectly as were the corn fritters.  I will eat here again for sure!

Love the north end co-op: Employees are upbeat and friendly, monthly sales deals are great and usually well marked, and, the Co-op's response to the pandemic and shopping has been fantastic. Their online ordering is good, although I am disappointed that they can't figure out how to make the pick up interaction less time consuming. For ex, you drive up, call the desk and tell them the color of your stall sign. So far, great.
Then a clerk comes out to retrieve your credit card.  She may return with your card and groceries,or it maybe just your card. In which case a third round trip is necessitated. Seems inefficient.

Otherwise. I love the feature, and appreciate the Co-op's quick learning curve
It came with a pool of oil. unfortunately, was not good. Their cornbread was really sweet.

It's busy and the wait can be long. Service is fair every time we're there. The portions are HUGE - almost too big. The menu has a lot to choose from. It's a good place for groups with lots of different tastes.

Positive:
Food tasted good and the service was great. 

Negative:
Way overpriced. Steak for two $100 for a bone-in ribeye. Half that at a prominent steak restaurant. 

Bottom line: 
Ambience is good. Service is solid. If you are looking to spend $400 for two couples, this is the place for you. For me - one and done.

First of all our server, Tonia/Tania(?), was great!  Maybe the kitchen was having a bad day. The food was okay, not good, not bad but okay. However the fried onions were just that; fried onions. No flavor, no seasoning.  My husband's steak was to be smothered with mushrooms and grilled onions but the mushrooms and onions were on the side in a very small metal ramakin. This placed reminded me of small town steakhouses in central Pennsylvania with fair bland food.

We love this place.  Delicious food and very gracious servers.  

The kids enjoy the drama of the cooking on the stove in front of you.  The food amounts are huge.

This is probably my husband's favorite place for Sunday morning breakfast after our past visit on June 30th.  We waited approximately 20 minutes for a table due to the crowd. The friendly hostess Jessica was so terrific about updating us on the wait and then she sat us in Carolyn's section. She promptly greeted us and brought us coffee. She was so upbeat and entertaining that we laughed the entire time we were there.  Our bacon was cooked to perfection - which we like it burnt and can rarely get it cooked correctly - shortly after we were given our coffee another server named Ralynne provided us with a refill while she was attending to her tables. It wasn't too long before the manager Steven stopped by our table and he also refilled our coffee.  The restaurant was extremely busy and there were people waiting upfront to be seated - thus the reason I found it so remarkable that not only did our server Carolyn provide us with exceptional service but several of the staff made sure that we had a great experience. Way to go Black Bear Diner - Great teamwork!!

We enjoyed impeccable service and an even better meal! The only negative is the chips and salsa were "extra" cost. We spent $22 on chips, Guac, salsa and queso.  It was literally enough food to where we won't really need to order a meal next time and the flavor was authentic and delicious. Great Margs and the best black refries beans we've ever had!  Can't wait to go back!!

We have started visit Sauce about once a week for date night. The veggie pizza was hot, and had the right amount of toppings. The Salmon Kale Salad was fresh and tasty.  We split it. 

The employees are very friendly, and checked on us to see if we need anything several times.  The waitstaff was constantly cleaning, which is a plus in my book. On the day we went there was a party of 31 eating in the dining room. We got our food in a very timely manner. 

It is a great place to grab lunch or dinner.

Came here on vacation for both breakfast and dinner and LOVED it. I've had a lot of Peruvian food and I really think this might be my favorite! We had salchicha and chicharron for breakfast and ceviche and chaufa for dinner. Everything was so flavorful and came out quickly. It can get a little packed but is definitely worth the wait!

Place is awesome....fresh tasty food thhat is chinese at its besst. Eggrolls are fantastic.
Lo mein is solid and sweet and sour chivcken is to die for. Good proces and good people.

Our first trip to Nashville but fourth day we discovered the Famous Saloon. What a find!  The singers performing were the best we had heard from about 25 different performances we had listened to. Our server Shelly, was fantastic!  She was super sweet and provided excellent service. We never ran out of drinks at any point. We have had some terrible service in Nashville but this was by far the best in town! Thanks Shelly for being our best server!We had appetizers as well and they were very good too. 
The floors, tables and restrooms were all very clean as well.

Food was delicious. I would definitely recommend to anyone who enjoys seafood. I also enjoyed sitting outside and dining. My only complaint is that they don't serve bread or something to nibble on when you arrive. They also forgot to give us plates and silverware so we had to ask for those things. But overall, I liked it and would return.
Great cheesesteaks, awesome sweet potato fries. Great spot, great food. Delivery was quick and efficient and it was nice to get some good quality comfort food while stuck at home.

I ordered the veggie burrito and the black beans tostadas. The burrito was so big that I couldnt even get to my tostadas. My boyfriend got the fish, chorizo and chicken tacos and loved all 3 of them! The food is amazing!!!! The ambiance is wonderful. I will come back. Laurie is the sweetest person! Thank you for the great food!!!

Great place! Interior is beautiful and food was fantastic. I got the chicken tikka masala and my friend got the shrimp tikka masala. Garlic naan was fresh and good! Only downside is they offer one plate of rice per table, which I didn't think was enough.
Fabulous service & devilishly inspired drinks. Maybe I was pulling for a little more from the food, but for a white-table place at those competitive prices... yeah, I'll get over it. Would go again.
A fantastic treat. The food is fantastic, I have gotten great service and portions are generous. I will Order again and if you haven't you will be glad you did

I was excited to try this new dim sum place and eagerly made the trek to the French Quarter today.  Unfortunately, I had a disappointing experience there. 

The place is pretty small so there was a 45 minute wait. They kindly took our number so they could call us when our table was ready. I believe we only waited about 30 minutes but that might be due to the problem they had in their kitchen. Apparently, something broke that rendered at least half the menu unavailable. The waiter was very apologetic and I certainly understand that these things happen. We ordered from what was available.

The food was . . . okay. It wasn't bad, certainly but it definitely didn't stand out as anything amazing. The pork bao and the shrimp bacon bites were pretty good. I liked the crepe but my boyfriend didn't. The basil chicken was ok but mostly breading. My boyfriend found it oddly sweet. The eggroll wasn't good. The food wasn't bad, just nothing I'd go out of my way to eat again.

I was really craving some sushi one afternoon for lunch and decided to order take-out from here. What's really cool is that their lunch special is still valid on Saturdays, which I got and also had their kimchi cheese fries. The sushi was pretty standard, not bad but not the best. Though, I would not really recommend the kimchi cheese fries, the fries themselves were a bit sogged (which may be due to it being a take-out meal), but didn't really have a lot of kimchi to start with and tasted kind of sweet? They seem to use processed cheese, ketchup(?), and Japanese mayo which was not cohesive when eaten all together. If I had another bad craving for an affordable sushi lunch, I'd hit them up again, but I'm sure that there are better options around as well.

Love it... Hawaiian options... how cool is that in the middle of Hoosier Land? 

A tiny place with interesting menu items. Great food, reasonable prices and friendly service. 

I enjoyed the Hawaii 5-0 breakfast and I enjoyed every bite of it. You get two eggs  your choice. I got scrambled and that was nicely done, not too dry, not underdone, just perfectly fluffy. Sliced tomatoes, nice touch. Coconut rice, yumm, has just a hint of coconut and sweetness to it and is a great offset to the saltiness of the Spam. The Spam by the way is awesome. I don't recall Spam ever tasting this good. But it was perfectly fired, just a tiny crisp on the outside, soft as can be on the inside. Wow. Add to that the wonderfully sweet grilled pineapple and you have an unusual but incredibly delicious breakfast. 
I am looking forward to trying other items on the menu...

My friend and I got to try this NOLA classic shortly before corona hit, and we all got sent to our rooms. 

The ambience alone is worth the visit, and my reason for suggesting it. I love the colorful lighting, the charming murals, the bric-a-brac on the walls...  

The food itself was good, but I wouldn't say the portions quite warrant the prices. 

My friend got  something called chicken pontalba. Comes with two sides, but they were both rather skimpy. 
I got the fried green tomatoes, which come with a shrimp remoulade on top. Very tasty--crispy, fresh, with extra plump shrimp.
Every meal comes with free cornbread, which might have been my favorite component. Nicely sweet with good crunch around the edges and garlic and herb butter. 

Overall, I might go back eventually but may never get more than an app.

Rented out an AirBnB nearby. Stopped by for a quick bite. Owner is friendly, and it's not too costly for a BBQ place. It does cost more than typical burger spots but hey you get what you pay for. Good quality meat. Beef Brisket Sandwich is great. And it is BYOB.

Authentic, Fresh, and Delicious...

East Bistro is a neighborhood eatery and coffee shop. Providing  flavors from east of the Mediterranean ( Lebanon, United Arab Emirates, Cyprus, Egypt, Morocco, Pakistan,Yemen to name a few) in my military career I've had the pleasure of tasting the truly authentic dishes from all over the Eastern Mediterranean region and let me say East Bistro hands down is as authentic and sitting at any eatery in any of the above mentioned countries. 

You must try the kebabs cooked to perfection. The Kibbeh hhhmmmm yummilicious I took a few quality pics (because we do eat with our eyes first) reasons television commercials makes us hungry LOL.

Try the Fatayer (which are traditional baked pastries stuffed with a variety of delicious fresh ingredients). 

For your sweet tooth Bosbousa, Baklava, and  Knafeh to name a few of the filo dough goodies. 

Drinks offered are coffees, teas, mochas, lattes, espressos and more.

Vegetarian Friendly with lots of Vegan Options and Halal. 

10/10 for Food, Value, and Service with price range of $5 - $15.

So make a trip to this fantastic Lebanese, Middle Eastern, Greek, Mediterranean restaurant for Yummilicious and Tastylicious cuisines.

*all meals are also available for take-out

Back again for Italian. We picked up 3
1/2 size pan lasagna, 1 will be a gift for a couple. And a bag of homemade ravioli,
Greek olives and a bag of wide egg noodles for  a casserole I ll make later. 

This place is so buried in the industrial area off Campbell Avenue. You have to turn in at the statue of Father Kino astride his horse. Then make your way back to Vine Street
. There will be a crowd of cars in front. 
In the store, A Wall of refers on one side & A  Italian Deli on the other. 
Bring money. 
You ll be hungry!

First time in, my husband and I wanted to try something different.

The customer service was terrible!  Honestly we should have left.

The main dish was colorful and tasty, the side was super dry it crumbled like dirt. 

Customer service is super important and can effect your entire dining experience.
We ordered in advance and it still took an additional 20 minutes to get our food. Do not pay online so you can just leave when you don't get your food.

If you are going to splurge you cannot go wrong with St. Elmo's or Harry & Izzy's. The Sunday abridged menu at St. Elmo's was more than enough food & ever so yummy! 
Where they lack in presentation, they certainly make up for in quality.

Bartaco is the best! I have lived in California & Texas and these tacos are up there with the best of them. Favorites include Baja, miso cod and Brussel sprouts. Love the margaritas and micheladas here as well but what's really special about this place is the staff. I am always impressed with each employee I come in contact with at any Bartaco location... they clearly hire the best. The manager at this location is Angela and she is absolutely wonderful- warm, welcoming and makes you feel like you are amongst friends... incredible hospitality! The company is lucky to have her. Thank you for another amazing experience at your restaurant- can't wait to come back!

I've been here twice and both times got the pineapple pizza. After the first time I ate the next day I was as sick as a dog, thought to give it another try. So i went last night and again woke up with the worst stomach ache.... don't think i will be going again

This was my go to place but not tonight food did not have the quality and flavor it has had for past 30 years I have been eating there.    Not sure if change of management or new cooking staff.  It was cool not hot as usual , sauce was watery when usually thicker and even egg rolls not the same.   Very disappointing.
Horrible food. My coconut shrimp was so burnt I threw it away! Inedible. Too far for me to drive back and return my takeout order. Such a disappointment.

Yummy crepes with plenty of options! I ordered the matcha chocolate truffles that had strawberries, truffles, matcha custard creme, whipped yogurt, chocolate sauce and crushed pistachio. I would love to come back to try the other ones. The crepes start at $6.95 and go up to $9.95. So kinda pricey for just one. This place also has a ramen restaurant combined so the seating is combined and a bit hectic. I tried some ramen and it was flavorful. Would recommend!
I absolutely love the Curry Tofu Bahni Mi and Tofu Summer Rolls. I highly recommend trying these options!

When my father wanted to go out he said let's go to Carmel. The food is just amazing for Mediterranean food. We truly enjoyed our meal and reminisced about when my mother used to come in with us. It brings a tear to my eye know that my mother is gone but I can still enjoy a good meal at Carmel. Stop in and the hostess will set you up with a nice table in the waitresses come up to you and take good care of you. Servers bring you your piping hot food right straight from the kitchen. It seems like there's always seating whether it's inside or out. Have have a cocktail while you're there, the bartender is always pouring!
Fantastic food and great service!! Always has all our food correct and timely!! Pad Thai is delicious we order then extra wet!

Thanks to the management and staff of Shop Rite Cinnaminson for your extraordinary efforts during the Covid-19 crisis. Although the check out line wrapped halfway around the store all the way to the back it moved remarkably fast. I was ready to just abandon my cart and leave when a woman in line told me that it is moving quickly. It gave me a chance to look around at many products and put more in my cart. Thank you Shop Rite!

Wow! We had one of the best dining experiences at Sushi Hatsu. The food was amazing including the taste, presentation, quality, and speed; service was phenomenal including very attentive, accommodating, and kind; atmosphere was cozy, clean, and engaging. We had a wonderful time and are excited to come back. We would all highly recommend it! I specifically would recommend getting a lot of fish-- more sushi and sashimi versus the rolls, but everything was amazing! We had one person in our party who is gluten free, and everything on the menu is clearly marked-- and they do offer gluten free soy sauce. Our table particularly enjoyed the hamachi Serrano, the unagi (eel) Sushi, and the chu-toro Sushi.. and don't forget to get dessert! The Yuzu cheesecake and the Green Tea Panna Cotta were absolutely delicious and unique desserts! Thank you Sushi Hatsu!
Not sure how to rate. Just wanted to update and say they don't deliver. Wa.sted 30 mins picking out dinne I won't get.

First time axe throwing! At first i was super nervous but Conner made me feel super safe and gave great pointers. End up having such an amazing time!!! Recommend 100%!!! Ask for Conner he's the best!!!

Me and my boyfriend had 3 drinks in an hour and a half, and one of the employees told everyone to stop serving us because it was "too much alcohol". Mind you, this was a Friday night and we were simply going out for a drink and a good time. Definitely would not recommend if you're trying to go out and have fun. Our first bartender was extremely nice, even offered us doubles if we wanted them, and after that it was just disappointing. Never going there again.

The service here was amazing, from the minute we walked through the door, the host was very nice and walked us to our table on the second floor while making conversation and getting to know us. Our server was very polite and helpful. The food was absolutely amazing and we were constantly checked on to see if everything was good. The manager came in and made sure that the food was good. Such great service. There is always one person walking around and disinfecting every table, great protocols in place to keep guest safe and healthy. Will definitely be back to this restaurant when I'm back to Nashville from Chicago!

The food wasn't bad and the service was good but I'm giving it 3 stars because the name of the place is crawfish & pho and they had no crawfish which was very disappointing because that was the reason why I visited the establishment. Also the noodle soup was good but only has 4 shrimp not really impressed. I guess you have to call ahead to find out if they have crawfish that day

This restaurant has the best sushi i have had in a long time!!! Don't let the small restaurant or strip mall deceive you, the quality is amazing!!! Definitely my new go to for sushi. I went with 4 girlfriends. We all had a salad/soup app. We had kani salad, seaweed salad, kani seaweed salad and clam miso soup. All were perfect!! For rolls we had out of control, angry dragon, alligator, snow mountain and Manhattan monkey then ordered two California rolls after we DEVOURED the first order!!

We were looking for a Vietnamese restaurant in downtown new orleans and we found this restaurant. We ordered the dumplings which were just okay. The spring rolls had really good peanut sauce. The pho's soup was a little bit too salty for us. The portions were large though.

This is well worth 5 stars !!!! The food was delicious , ribs were tender, savory, slid right off the bone! Their homemade bbq sauce is like no other I've tried, a bit of a tangy, sweet with spice! Service is just great! I love supporting local businesses with great people !!! I highly recommend! Good to see masks and social distancing enforced too! Thank you for continuing to provide good quality food for our community.

Love this place. Owners were so nice , greeted us at the door , with a smile (Classic) Food was fresh, gave my friend a piece of falafel to try (cuz she wasnt sure if she liked it) Food was ready quick too!! Will be back. First Yelp review for a reason. Gotta check this place out

Awesome breakfast spot in Manayunk!
I came here with my boyfriend for breakfast on a Saturday. We ordered a latte with almond milk, coffee, a bagel sandwich, and a slice of vegan zucchini bread. 
The bread and latte were delicious! My boyfriend enjoyed his food as well. 
The space is well decorated. When the bar isn't open in the back you can sit it any of the tables in the space. 
Friendly service and great breakfast!

Like a dope, I ordered the simplest thing on the menu and had to watch as others around me received incredible dishes, from huevos rancheros to a beautiful scramble. 

Luckily, my simple meal was also good. I was able to add onion to my hashbrown and my eggs were nice and easy, something no other restaurant in Nashville was able to accomplish. My husband's kernel biscuit was smothered in gravy and could have been lightened up with a fresher ingredient, though overall it was a winner. 

Also, the restaurant was so well-staffed. We were waited on by 4 different people. The atmosphere was also lovely. 

No complaints here. One of the best breakfasts you could have around Nashville.
Payday Friday I choose to eat here, they didn't give me no silver ware or  condiments . So check your bag before you leave.

This is my second time here and we had the amazing Abbey as our server! It is always pretty busy but our server managed to check up on us frequently and made us feel very safe and comfortable! The food was great and the service was incredible. (:
Will not be returning. I've never seen a group of employees so unmotivated to work before.

I have read others reviews about the slow service and I agree that this place is slow to give you your ordered items.  The burgers are not like the Lotaburger's in New Mexico.  They taste different and the buns taste stale.  If you order hatch chili you get such a small amount on the burger so why order it.  The only reason I gave 3 stars is because of the bacon breakfast burrito , but lately they have been putting less hash browns so I will try again to see if this is now the norm.

So usually the Honu it is an amazing place to be, but today was a complete disappointment. There was an extremely drunk older man there with a big group of women who is yelling All sorts of profanities and F bombs with an earshot of everybody in the back area, and I was hoping the manager would ask him to keep it down but it took an 80-year-old man (a customer!!) to walk up to him and ask him to keep his mouth shut after 45 minutes of the rudeness. I would ask management from now on to take a proactive step to ask people like that to leave because it really kills the ambience of this place has when everyone is behaving. Love the food love the place, but today was extremely disappointing

Horrible. I spent $65 on three items to be delivered. The woman delivering my order texted me that my food was left at my door which in fact it was NOT because I was standing outside waiting for it. Then I called her asking where my food Was
was and she said she dropped the food off at #903 which I specifically wrote my apartment number two different times at check out. I watched her pick up my pizza that was left outside another apartment door and brought it to me. The food was so cold by the time I got it and the wings were absolutely horrible, tasted like old grease.

This was one of the first bars we stopped at while we bar hopped. It's a nice bar, though I feel they need to move the live music a bit back from the entrance. Fighting through a bunch of people just to get a drink. We went to the second floor and the band was more interested in talking to a few girls standing there than playing music.

Absolutely the worst pizza delivery in STL. We placed an order at 11:30 pm and kept having to repeatedly call for an update because our pizza never showed. At 12:50 we were told it was on the way. At 1:15 we called because the restaurant was .5 miles away. They told us our order had been cancelled. We waited 2 hours for a pizza that was never coming! Absolutely ridiculous. When I asked for a refund on my card they hung up on me and said "have a good night". Robert Nelson was the manager on duty.
food was great but the service was subpar. waited 50 mins for our food, it was cold when it arrived and consistently had an empty cup.
Enjoying the new location in Oakville. Everything I've tried on the menu is delicious. A couple of times products weren't ready but I chalk that up to a new store.

Great food, but not worth the countless health violations. I'd actually report these guys to the health department, but i can't find an easy way to do it. While dining there today, I witnessed on multiple occasions, the cashier scooping macaroni and cheese into his hand from the tray and eating it out of his hand. Only on one of those occasions did he wash it. He only gloved one hand while handling food and using the other nongloved hand to adjust buns or other items on the plate. For example he rubbed his non glove hand, the hand that he previously ate Mac and cheese out of, inside of a bowl trying to grab it before scooping soup into it. Additionally an employee was picking his face and handled the ladles and scoopers before washing his hands. Eating there today, I lost my appetite and all respect for this place. I'll never dine there again and I was sure to notify everyone I work with of the disgusting practices of that establishment.
One of the few places open, I am so glad they were. Amazing breakfast, very friendly and attentive staff. Do yourself a favor and get their gouda grits.
I went here and was delighted to see a Gluten free menu! The pasta was so yummy! The staff was very friendly and the wait time was not bad at all, prices were also good:)
Really great food and great experience. The staff is very friendly and will help you if you need help assembling your food. I certainly didn't know how lol. Am definitely coming back again.

Bartaco is definitely one of my favorite spots in Tampa. They have a fair selection of different meats and toppings, including duck, tuna, pork belly, and even a fried avocado (it's off menu, but one of the best ones they have there).
Having a girlfriend with Celiacs, they are very accommodating and most of the tacos on the menu are safe for gluten free folks, and are very adjusted on the issue. 
If you want some good tacos at a very fair price, this is an essential for the Tampa area. Not a single complaint about this place.

Very few restaurants have the consistency of this little place located on Milwaukee next to target. Great Thai food, usually in here for lunch and get the cash or not chicken lunch special which has the fried wonton stuffed with cream cheese with it. Comes with a bowl of amazing Sizling Rice Soup, Several levels of spice, this place is awesome and for anyone that hasn't been here it is a real find. Quick service fresh food, what else could you want!

This has been our go to and frankly only
Place we are comfortable eating at during covid

Everyone is taking the safety measures seriously

Food is AMAZING ALWAYS.
Whether you are a meat eater, vegetarian, etc you will find plenty to eat. 

They have indoor and outdoor seating. They have heaters for outdoor seating

I always get their chai tea with almond milk-SO GOOD!

Their portions are fantastic and their service alone would earn them 10 stars.
Every single team member we have ever come across is so cheerful, its truly a pleasure.

Great for work meetings 1:1, larger gatherings, solo meals, to go meals, all of it.

Oh they have beer too!

Tons of parking as its in a huge parking lot at
Legends. The parking lot is very close
To the restaurant as well
Food is fine. The service is horrendous. I shouldn't have to ask for boxes and the check 3 times before someone finally remembers.

Delicious bagels but staffing needs MAJOR work. My husband and I come here all the time and it takes about 20 minutes to get two toasted bagels with cream cheese. For a bagel place, I find that time table ridiculous. Based upon a neighborhood FB group, so do so many of our neighbors.
Everything was fantastic. Great atmosphere in a space that has a lot of character. Service was great, very attentive wait staff. The food was incredible as well.

Went for a lunch and sat outside, server was great, bread
Was great, our entrees were not good . I had a salad with shrimp and avocado, avocado was mush, salad had no flavor.
We also had a chicken caprese sandwich, there were not even tomatoes on it.

Cute little diner. I love the "local" feel of the place. Very good prices and alot of sandwiches, breakfast, and entree options. Quick service and super friendly people! I got the tuna melt, which was perfect, and my friend got an omelette which he finished as well. Will make sure to stop by every time I'm in fishtown!
Delicious food, great service. On travel and stumbled into this place for a nice WIN!!!

I ordered for delivery a couple of times here, and the food was yummy. I especially liked the pork ribs, small portion for the price but excellent flavor. Also really good were the noodle salad, Gyuma sausage and Tibetan beef satay, they come with a lovely hot sauce that is just the right spice level. It would be great if they also had sukuti, a sort of Himalayan version of beef jerky that I'd seen in some New York City restaurants. I definitely hope to visit in person one day soon.

Stopped by for drinks and an appetizer, so my experience is limited but even from that limited experience I can tell that......The place is expensive!!!!!!!!!!!!
3 beers, 1 glass of wine, 1 iced tea, 1 club soda (they don't have normal sparking water....) and 1 appetizer (including taxes and tip): 75$???????
The appetizer was not great....the bell peppers had so much garlic that we couldn't eat them, the Parmesan was ok (after all it is a cheese, comes in a package) and literally 1/2 grilled artichoke split in 2...
A wonderful little inner city grocery BUT best thing are the tables to sit and enjoy a drink with friends and watch the world go by. So many choices to choose from and great music!

Finally drove out of our neck of the woods and made it out to this place for a try. My family loves BBQ and Rotisserie meat so here we are. Inside is very clean, modern with an upscale vibe. There are games near the hostess station that you can bring to your table. We chose Uno to play while we waited for our food. Great idea as it kept my 7 year old occupied. I wanted to love it here but the whole experience just fell a short. Most of the food looked better than it tasted.

We ordered the RR Knuckle Sandwich, pulled pork sandwich, full rack of ribs, 2 meat rotisserie sampler, and pesto Zoodles. The food looked great but sadly underwhelming.
Pesto Zoodles : not exactly pesto and not exactly Zoodles. It was very oily and lacking in flavor.
The ribs literally fell apart but not in a good way. They may have been parboiled and had the texture of stewed meat and no Smokey flavor. The worst part was how much thick dark BBQ sauce was on top. Definitely order the sauce on the side to see if you even like the flavor (we didn't). My 7 year old, a Pulled pork connoisseur, didn't love his food. He hated the dry ciabatta bread. He asked me later why restaurants try to make the food too fancy, lol. He likes just a regular bun. In any case, he barely finished half which is saying a lot. Seriously, this kid is a very husky 7 and no joke behind a plate. The rotisserie plate and tri-tip were probably the best thing at the table. Tri tip and chicken were juicy and flavorful. 

Prices are on the

A few of my girlfriends and I came to Nashville for the weekend and had to stop by here! The kimchi spring rolls, pad Thai, cheese board, and avocado margs were to die for!! Definitely going to think about the food here back home and will have to come back for sure.

Previous experiences with Ming's have been positive.  Ordered take out for three tonight, and the food was tasteless.  The dumplings were good, but everything else was devoid of flavor.  I was very excited to enjoy the Ming's of the past, but was ultimately disappointed with this evening's experience.  The food packaging and temperature, for our short trip home, was more than sufficient.  I just wish the flavor had been as good!

Great wings, great service and atmosphere. 
One of my favorite places to eat and watch sports!
Delicious spring rolls and sushi and shrimp fried rice. The prices are reasonable too. I love this place !!

I've had a craving for some egg drop soup and sushi. This place is close to home, so I decided to give them a try. I'm not crazy about buffets, but I saw that I could order online, thru Yelp, and pick up my dinner. The process was simple, I paid online and was notified my food would be ready in 20-40 minutes. 

20 minutes later, I recieved a call from a very polite woman, letting me know that my order was ready. I went up and picked up my 6 piece Dynamite Roll, egg drop soup and egg roll. Service was quick, polite and friendly, and she made sure I had everything I needed. 

My Dynamite Roll was delicious and really hit the spot. My egg roll was decent, but smaller than I was expecting. I realized that's why they only charge $1.50 for their egg rolls. The sweet and sour sauce that she went and got for me, for my egg roll, from the buffet was really food. I got pretty excited when I saw the giant container of egg drop soup, thinking I'd have plenty left over for maybe even 2 lunches. However, it was absolutely foul. As soon as I took the lid off, my heart sank, because it smelled funky. It tasted like burnt rubber or something. 

All in all, it was pretty good experience, minus the soup. Bummed I didn't get a fortune cookie, either. But I'll definitely order pick up from here again.

I love Daily Eats. 

Yup.

The diner is pretty tight, it's a little funky and the parking situation can be bleak. The service is nothing overly sensational and there is almost always a wait. Stay with me here folks, it's entirely worth it. Daily Eats doesn't need fancy service and it doesn't even need to be convenient. It's just good! 

Even though there is usually a wait (especially brunch on the weekends) I personally never wait. How? you ask. No, it's not because of my world famous Instagram captions. It's because I always opt to sit at the bar. Wham bam thank you ma'am. That's your tip of the day. 

The menu is really eclectic and I don't know exactly what to think of it. I do believe the breakfast foods are the best. The bowls also hold a special place is my heart. The portions are generous and the food is made with real, fresh ingredients. The fruit is always colorful, I've never seen an avocado toast be any shade other than bright green. 

If there is one item you surely can't miss, it is hands down the captain crunch french toast. You can order the captain crunch french toast as a side order, this means you can order a savory brunch AND still get a sweet bite! This is impotent because let's face it, sweet or savory at brunch is one of life's most agonizing decisions. (Look ya that 2 tips for today and all in one review.) 

Daily Eats is a staple in Tampa Bay. And I personally love having it be one of our culinary differentiators. 

Currently offering takeout and deliv

They have vegan cheese here!!! I am so happy to eat a pizza and not have to have it with sauce only. Their pizza here is absolutely-incredible-mouth-watering-can't-wait-to-come-back-here pizza. And it will do just that, keep you coming back!

I have always loved this place and have been here many times. Staff is always inviting and friendly. Loved our waitress tonight, I can't remember her name but she was such a great waitress. You could tell she really loved her job. 

Next time you walk by this place, stop and give it a try, you will not be displeased!

If you have a sweet tooth like me, make sure you stop by this donut shop. My donut was light and fluffy and the though I enjoyed it, I found the raspberry icing to be a tad too sweet. The iced matcha was a nice break from all the southern cooking I was having but nothing special.

We have eaten at the one in Eagle several times.  The food was always good, and the staff was nice.  It is hard for mento give five stars to fast food but I believe they could easily be a four star restaurant.  

The company advertises earning points by scanning receipts to get discounts on meals.  Every time I have gone inside to the restaurant in the Eagle Island shopping center I am unable to use my points because they do not have Wifi.

This should be corrected since I have been able to redeem points at the restaurants on Eagle Road, in Meridian, and the one in Downtown Boise.

Horrible location! We were seated and sat for 9 minutes before I am assuming our server literally tossed napkins and silverware on our table while yelling to another table "give me one minute!" Not a single word or eye contact with or to us! He went and printed a receipt delivered it to a table, then went to ANOTHER table and at that point we got up and left. NEVER AGAIN WILL we come to this location. Carrollwood is much better and well worth the drive!!!

Found this hike in the wall spot via yelp. It's hard to find good mexican reaturant in Jersey. However this place is absolutely delicious. The staff is super friendly. Plenty of outdoor parking. Indoor and outdoor seating available. The menu is huge. They even have pizza which was perfect for the kids. I would highly recommend this place.

Waited 45 minutes for food that never came, with server continually telling us "it's almost ready".  Watched several other parties who ordered after us get their food.  We left and came to Chick-fil-a.

Edit:  Chili's response shows that they didn't even read my original post.  We didn't wait to be seated.  We were seated quickly.  Our food never came, after 45 minutes of waiting.  That was the issue.  Had we walked in and been told that there was a 45 minute wait to be seated, we would have just left.  Instead, we spent an hour at the restaurant for a round of sweet tea.  

The Chick-fil-a we got was pretty great though.

We ordered our family dinner(take out) for Sunday evening. You can really tell when the people who make your food not only do not take pride in what they do but just don't care. Chicken and lamb dry as could be. Rice did not even have a taste or flavor... my dog would not even eat it. All these great reviews must be from the owners and their friends. Absolutely pitiful and sad. Not interested in trying this place ever again.

Another delicious meal!  We decided to celebrate our family's January birthday members this evening (5 out of 13).  About half of us had been there and the other half had not.  We were excited to share with them your yummy food.  Big beers and giant pork shanks!  Everything else was super delicious the pork schnitzel with mushroom gravy was so tender.  I could eat the cucumber salad everyday.  My grandmother ordered the fish and chips and my word it was a huge piece of fish!!  But the thing everyone loved a lot (not that they didn't like their food) was the Ruben rolls.  Seriously I'm going back to just order those and a beer before shopping one day. A special thanks to everyone who treated my family so sweet for all of these birthdays.  From or server to the music we truly had a wonderful meal!

We had another wonderful dinner at Sullivan's it is a up scale steak house that is just fantastic. The staff is very attentive and friendly. 
We would recommend Sullivan's to people who love a great steak and super good food.
It's fantastic! I've been there 3x and it been delicious each time. The California Fajitas are on point. Highly recommended.
Fantastic! Food was great and came out timely! Margs are also super great and can be purchased as singles, a pitcher, or even gallon to go! Our waitress was super nice and quick with service!

My family and I arrived for dinner/breakfast at8:05. The place was literally empty. A total of five tables with people in the chairs. I had to find someone just for waters. Orders were taken and after being there 40 minutes the food comes out. Pancakes were burnt, eggs were cold and the order wasn't right. There answer is would you like to talk to a manager?  No I would like what I ordered in a timely manner please. Service sucked, food sucked. Go spend your HARD EARNED MONEY SOMEWHERE ELSE. All this with only five tables occupied.

Nice people, but a BLT on burnt toast. Really? $9 BLT.  Not what I'd expect ... surely you can do better. 

I got it with mixed greens which apparently means "spinach".

The hush puppies are 

Food is always great and service is always fast. 

1 negative thing: if you pull up to the window and place the order, the girls get annoyed and tell me "Make sure you call ahead if you want to use the window"
Nachos were amazing and the bartender was so nice. Great spot for sports. Stop on by and support your local places
